help.summary: Runs MCP server instances A and B in one process with the real SDK transport: the client disconnects from A and reconnects to B with Last-Event-ID. Shows which stores actually resume.
help.backend: --backend <name>  Store to try: all (default), memory, sqlite, redis
help.lang: --lang <en|ko>    Output language (also MCP_STREAMSTORE_LANG, then LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG)
help.env: Environment: REDIS_URL=redis://host:6379 uses a real Redis for --backend redis (install the 'redis' package); without it the practice fake (mock) Redis is used.
error.badBackend: Unknown backend: {value} (expected all, memory, sqlite or redis)
error.noSdk: This demo needs the MCP SDK: npm install @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
error.noRedisClient: REDIS_URL is set but the 'redis' package is not installed: npm install redis
error.redisConnect: Could not connect to REDIS_URL: {message} Check that the server is running, the host and port are right, and the password is correct.
demo.title: mcp-streamstore demo: disconnect from instance A, reconnect to instance B
demo.mockBanner: [practice fake (mock) Redis] Not a real server: an in-process imitation of the few Redis commands this library uses. Set REDIS_URL for a real Redis.
demo.section.resume: 1) Resume on another instance: the client received 1 event from A, then reconnected to B with Last-Event-ID
demo.section.leak: 2) Two sessions on one shared store: the SDK names every session's GET stream "_GET_stream"
demo.section.stateful: 3) Stateful session (Mcp-Session-Id) resumed on another instance
demo.store.example: SDK example InMemoryEventStore, one per instance
demo.store.memoryShared: MemoryEventStore, one object shared in this process
demo.result.silent: replayed 0 (silent: looks fine, but the 3 missed events are lost)
demo.col.cross: X resumes with Y's event ID
demo.stateful.plain: B resumes the session as is
demo.lesson: Lesson: resumption only works when every instance reads the same store, scoped per session.
